description.en: A precision shim ring to DIN 988, 5 mm inside and 10 mm outside diameter, sold in fixed thicknesses. On an M5 screw used as an axle it spaces an idler or a flanged bearing from its host and from its neighbours; unlike a stamped washer its thickness is held to a standard.
description.es: Un anillo suplemento de precisión según DIN 988, de 5 mm de diámetro interior y 10 mm exterior, vendido en espesores fijos. Sobre un tornillo M5 usado como eje separa una polea loca o un rodamiento con pestaña de su anfitrión y de sus vecinos; a diferencia de una arandela estampada, su espesor se ajusta a una norma.
description.fr: Une rondelle de calage de précision selon DIN 988, diamètre intérieur 5 mm et extérieur 10 mm, vendue en épaisseurs fixes. Sur une vis M5 utilisée comme axe, elle écarte un galet ou un roulement à collerette de son hôte et de ses voisins ; contrairement à une rondelle emboutie, son épaisseur suit une norme.
description.pt: Um anel de calço de precisão segundo a DIN 988, com 5 mm de diâmetro interior e 10 mm exterior, vendido em espessuras fixas. Num parafuso M5 usado como eixo afasta uma polia louca ou um rolamento com flange do seu hospedeiro e dos vizinhos; ao contrário de uma anilha estampada, a espessura segue uma norma.

sources.title: DIN 988 shim ring 5x10x1 mm, steel (product datasheet 1009885101)
sources.supports: DIN 988, d1 5 mm, d2 10 mm, s 1 mm; thickness variants for d1 5: 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 1 and 1.5 mm

sources.title: Voron 2.4r2 build guide, version 2023-07-04 (VoronDesign/Voron-2 @ a192410, Manual/Assembly_Manual_2.4r2.pdf, GPL-3.0); cited by page and section only, nothing copied
sources.supports: p. 8 (Hardware reference): shims to DIN 988 at every M5 call-out, not stamped washers; pp. 65 and 69 (A/B Drives and Idlers): M5 shims either side of the F695 pair on the M5x40 SHCS. The guide names no shim thickness.

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of face A, on the axis. +z runs through the ring to face B at z = thickness_mm. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the ring is round, so every interface has continuous symmetry.

thickness_min.note: the thinnest listed variant for d1 5

thickness_max.note: the thickest listed variant for d1 5

parameters.note: Sold in 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 1 and 1.5 mm for d1 5 (cited); use one of those. The default, 1 mm, is the variant the cited datasheet describes; the Voron guide names no thickness, so it is a catalog convention.

interfaces.note: Female: the ring's bore receives the screw's shank. Framed at face A, normal −z out of the face.
Neutral: face A bears on the next part of a stack.
Neutral: face B, thickness_mm along the axis, bears on the next part of a stack.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-AUTH-E lane, 2026-10-04); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: A DIN 125 / ISO 7089 washer is a different part (stamped, looser thickness); this entry is the DIN 988 shim only.
